Name: But There Were Emergencies Harvey
Author: ClawClawClaw
Description:
Imagine it's Winter Star year 1. You're talking to the NPCs and thinking about all the things that have happened that year. You get to Harvey and he says "I'm thankful there were no medical emergencies this year!" Seriously? Shane needing his stomach pumped wasn't an emergency? The "emergency surgery" after that failed skull cavern dive somehow wasn't an emergency? None of the various modded characters who had clinic cutscenes were emergencies? Did Harvey forget?

Fear not! There is a cure for Harvey's memory loss while keeping him in character with his doctor-themed festival dialogue. Using Content Patcher, this mod simply replaces the dialogue line with a new one.

[b]Vanilla line:[/b] "I'm thankful there were no medical emergencies this year!"
[b]Modded line:[/b] "I'm thankful so many people got their flu vaccines this year!"

Should be fully compatible with any mod that doesn't also replace Harvey's Winter Star dialogue line.

Shoutout to some wonderful NPC mods that go nicely with this mod:
[spoiler][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5599]Jasper[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]Sword & Sorcery[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16197]Bear Family[/url][/spoiler]

( Special thanks to the friendly folks over on the East Scarp discord who helped me learn Content Patcher <3 )

Manifest.Name: But There Were Emergencies
